title: Transfer of a Unary Computation
statement: Let $M$ be a finite deterministic machine over the binary alphabet, and let $x$ and $v$ be binary words and $t$ a natural number. If $M$ computes output $v$ within $t$ steps on the all-ones word of length $|x|$, then the input-normalized machine associated with $M$ computes output $v$ within $t$ steps on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite deterministic machine over the binary alphabet
$M$ computes $v$ within $t$ steps on the all-ones input of length $|x|$
replaced: Let $M$ be a deterministic machine over the binary alphabet and suppose $M$ computes an output $v$ within $t$ steps on the all-ones input of length $|x|$. Then the input-normalized variant of $M$ computes $v$ within $t$ steps on the input $x$ itself.
